text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain urges global aid for Palestinian refugees.
- New three-million dinar cancer treatment centre to start operating on Saturday.
- Islamic financial bodies needed to fund projects, senior banker says.
- Labour minister says Bahrain to take steps to encourage the private sector to employ more Bahrainis.
- Gulf Air board of directors meets in Muscat on Wednesday.
- Citibank representatives in 23 countries to meet in Bahrain next week to discuss 1997 goals.
